items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: Freddie Greene was there on guitar... this was -- well, the date was Joe Turner's, and the name of the album... is The Boss of the Blues.

ctx.x: What did he play? Oh, the saxophone player -- oh, I'll recall his name in a second, but go on while I think -- he was a great saxophone player. [Hershel Evans]

Well, he had added Freddie Greene and I was there the night Lips called me over, and there was a little men's toilet with a little ratchet on the door and he said to come on in here, that he wanted me to meet somebody, and he said, 'This is Lester Young' -- and there weren't any extra beers around, so he said to send one up -- it was just 15¢ and I had to scrounge around for 15¢, and I saw the band growing.
Oh yes, and he added Walter Page who he brought up from St. Louis -- not the Cotton Club, but ...
